description: Canonical emission-source families and source types used by Layer 1. A template or rule may only create a POTENTIAL candidate; user review is required before confirmation.
scope_note: Every default scope is provisional. Final scope depends on the reporting boundary, ownership or operational control, and the nature of the transaction.
calculation_note: Industry type and identification confidence are never emission multipliers. Quantification requires confirmed activity data and a compatible, versioned emission factor.

source_families.name: Stationary combustion
source_families.description: Fuel burned in fixed equipment such as boilers, furnaces, ovens, dryers, heaters and generators.

source_families.name: Mobile combustion
source_families.description: Fuel burned in company-controlled vehicles and mobile equipment.

source_families.name: Purchased energy
source_families.description: Electricity, heat, steam or cooling purchased for facility operations.

source_families.name: Industrial process emissions
source_families.description: Greenhouse gases released directly by physical, chemical or biological processing rather than fuel combustion.

source_families.name: Fugitive emissions
source_families.description: Intentional or unintended equipment-related releases such as refrigerant leakage.

source_families.name: Purchased goods and services
source_families.description: Upstream emissions associated with purchased raw materials, packaging, chemicals and services.

source_families.name: Transportation and distribution
source_families.description: Company-controlled or third-party movement of materials, products and waste.

source_families.name: Waste generated in operations
source_families.description: Treatment and disposal of operational solid and liquid waste.

source_families.name: Wastewater generation and treatment
source_families.description: Direct or value-chain emissions from wastewater collection and treatment.

source_families.name: Outsourced operations
source_families.description: Manufacturing or operational activity performed by a third party outside direct organizational control.

source_types.name: Stationary fuel combustion
source_types.scope_rule: Scope 1 when the combustion equipment is owned or operationally controlled by the reporting company.

source_types.name: Mobile fuel combustion
source_types.scope_rule: Scope 1 for vehicles or mobile equipment under operational control; otherwise classify the transport service in the applicable Scope 3 category.

source_types.name: Purchased grid electricity
source_types.scope_rule: Scope 2 for electricity purchased and consumed by the reporting facility.

source_types.name: Purchased heat, steam or cooling
source_types.scope_rule: Scope 2 when heat, steam or cooling is purchased from an external supplier and consumed by the facility.

source_types.name: Industrial process emissions
source_types.scope_rule: Scope 1 when greenhouse gases are released by a process operated or controlled by the reporting company.

source_types.name: Refrigerant leakage and release
source_types.scope_rule: Scope 1 for releases from refrigeration or air-conditioning equipment under operational control.

source_types.name: Other fugitive greenhouse-gas releases
source_types.scope_rule: Scope depends on the gas, equipment and operational control.

source_types.name: Purchased raw materials, packaging and chemicals
source_types.scope_rule: Selected Scope 3 Category 1 when cradle-to-gate emissions of purchased goods or services are included.

source_types.name: Fuel- and energy-related activities not included in Scope 1 or 2
source_types.scope_rule: Selected Scope 3 Category 3 for upstream fuel and energy emissions that are not already counted in Scope 1 or Scope 2.

source_types.name: Upstream transportation and distribution
source_types.scope_rule: Selected Scope 3 Category 4 for third-party transportation and distribution of purchased goods when not owned or controlled by the reporting company.

source_types.name: Downstream transportation and distribution
source_types.scope_rule: Selected Scope 3 Category 9 for qualifying third-party transportation of sold products; review Category 4 treatment when the reporting company purchases the transport service.

source_types.name: Waste generated in operations
source_types.scope_rule: Selected Scope 3 Category 5 when waste is treated by a third party; controlled onsite treatment may create Scope 1 emissions.

source_types.name: Onsite wastewater treatment
source_types.scope_rule: Scope 1 when methane or nitrous oxide is emitted by wastewater treatment under operational control.

source_types.name: Offsite wastewater treatment
source_types.scope_rule: Selected Scope 3 Category 5 when wastewater generated by operations is treated by a third party.

source_types.name: Outsourced manufacturing or processing
source_types.scope_rule: Selected Scope 3 Category 1 when a supplier performs manufacturing or processing purchased by the reporting company; review classification for the applicable value-chain relationship.
